title: Canadian Bacon Braised in a Rich Brown Sauce
description: A hearty and comforting dish featuring tender Canadian bacon in a rich brown sauce, perfect for a cozy dinner. This recipe is a twist on traditional braised meats, with a focus on the unique flavor of Canadian bacon.
instructions: Season the Canadian bacon with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the Canadian bacon over medium heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the Canadian bacon from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the brown sugar, heavy cream, bacon drippings, flour, and beef broth to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the Canadian bacon to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 hours, or until the Canadian bacon is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the Canadian bacon and sauce over mashed potatoes or egg noodles.
